summary: Sources give 2 different answers to “How many days did Emmett Shear serve as OpenAI's interim CEO before Sam Altman's return?”: 2 (1 source), 3 (2 sources). No primary source found.

text: Sources agree that the OpenAI board fired Sam Altman as CEO on 2023-11-17. They disagree on how many days Emmett Shear served as interim CEO before Altman's return, with some saying 3 days and others saying 2. No primary source in this run settles the disputed points.
